title: Membership in the binary multiplication table
statement: Let $\ell>0$, and let a certified binary field implementation of dimension $\ell$ be given. For all binary vectors $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, the triple consisting of $x$, $y$, and their modular product belongs to the multiplication table formed from all binary vectors of that dimension.
hypotheses_covered: A certified binary field implementation of dimension $\ell$
